title: Calling the server from a page
summary: A page gets data from Yon through an HTTP client. An annotated HTTPClient belongs in client/remotes and its Service receives it through Needs. A request to another host needs that host in tac.outgoing.hosts. The dedicated C# example below uses a registered scalar Task result; the F# example uses an explicitly owned BehaviorContext and Task<BehaviorJSON>. The older catalog section includes C# and F# collection and self-constructed-client snippets that remain unqualified migration material. Use the two dedicated examples for the currently qualified browser contracts; broader collection, typed F# client and shared-provider support remain separate work.
